title: Reconstructing hair, eyes and teeth from images

queue.claim: Appearance-based gaze networks reach about 4–5° error within the lab datasets (MPIIGaze, ETH-XGaze) and about 10–11° on Gaze360. IR-glint eye trackers reach about 0.5–1°. Fitting the iris edge on high-resolution photos plausibly reaches 1–3°.
queue.query: L2CS-Net MPIIGaze Gaze360 angular error degrees appearance-based gaze estimation

queue.claim: MediaPipe Iris assumes a horizontal iris diameter of about 11.7 mm (±0.5) for metric depth (Ablavatski et al. 2020). MediaPipe Face Landmarker outputs 478 points, with 468–477 on the irises (5 per eye), plus 52 ARKit-style blendshape scores.
queue.query: MediaPipe Iris 11.7 mm horizontal iris diameter depth estimation relative error landmarks 468-477
